concepts.prompt: A channel marker gate for the mouth of a sea current lane: two tall weathered driftwood marker posts about 6 m apart, each post thick, slightly crooked, lashed with rope bands and topped with a teal-and-cream painted cap, set in small rock piles; a sagging thick rope strung between the post tops carrying a row of small triangular cloth pennants in teal, sand and white; a round teal-and-cream striped float buoy hanging from the middle of the rope. Real size about 6 m wide, 5 m tall. Front three-quarter view. Stylised Palworld/Animo-class game prop concept, same family as the attached Tidewake woven reed hall and dock shelter: chunky readable shapes, warm sun-bleached weathered driftwood timber, golden woven reed and thatch, sun-bleached rope bindings, teal and sea-blue paint accents, cream sailcloth, clean hand-painted PBR finish. Use the attached boards only for palette, mood and finish quality. Absolutely no red, no oxblood, no crimson, no maroon anywhere. Single isolated object, full object visible, plain neutral light background, no text, no labels, no people, no creatures.

concepts.verdict: CHOSEN (view 0): two crooked driftwood posts with teal/cream striped caps, rope bands, rock bases, double sagging rope with teal/sand/white pennants and a teal/cream buoy
